## STEP DOWN TREATMENT
Step down treatment for completion of antimicrobial course after initial
intravenous treatment in patients who can tolerate oral therapy. Base selection
on culture results.
## Gastrointestinal Infections
[Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg PO q12h [R]](psjzid-amoxicillin-clavulanate-875-125-mg-po-q12h)
< OR >
[Cefdinir 300 mg PO q12h [R] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg PO q12h [DI]](orz-set-abx-cefdinir-300mg-po-q12h-metronidazole-500mg-po-q12h)
< OR >
[Ciprofloxacin 500 mg PO q12h [R,DI] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg PO q12h [DI]](orz-set-abx-ciprof-500mg-po-q12h-metro-500mg-po-q12h)
< OR >
[Trimethoprim-Sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tab q12h [R] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg PO](orz-set-abx-trimeth-sulfa-ds-q12h-metro-500mg-po-q12h)
q12h [DI]
Inpt: ORZID2 GMENU ABX STEP DOWN TREATMENT
Outpt: ORZID3 GMENU ABX STEP DOWN TREATMENT
